rationale: X matches the references: it finds the decisive initializer-order fact that API-only applications already receive an implicit CookieStore configuration before middleware construction, making the proposed predicate true for stock API apps. It correctly shows that the patch adds Cookies but still not Session, conflicts with the documented opt-in model and exact API middleware-stack test, and risks duplicate Cookies for apps following the guide. It also covers the requested manual middleware, disabled-session, request, ordering, test-gap, and compatibility cases and proposes a coherent narrower design only conditionally.
